app.title: Open MicroManipulator – A sub-micrometer 3D motion control plattform
app.author: _Microft
app.description: Firmware and control library for a sub‑micrometer 3‑D motion platform using a stepper‑motor driver.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and build firmware using the provided Makefile.
Flash compiled binary onto a compatible microcontroller and verify boot messages.
Send a sequence of stepper commands via the CLI and capture motor response with an oscilloscope.
Measure the latency between command issuance and motor position change for a 1000‑step sequence.
Run the bundled Python API example and confirm it can read encoder feedback.
